text: もって　いかないで　くれい！

structure.jp: もって　いかないで

patterns.name: 〜ないでくれ
patterns.span: いかないで　くれい
patterns.explanation: ないで plus くれ asks someone plainly not to do something. The extra い is an old-man flourish. いかないで　くれい = 'please don't go'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.span: もって　いかないで
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb says the action moves away from here. 'Hold and go' means to take away. もって　いかないで = 'don't take it away'.
